records.name: Conseil de Paris
records.decision_basis: Municipal/departmental hybrid below the regional tier. CGCT L2512-1 combines commune and department competences, not an autonomous territorial legislature. A special-status label does not supply a substantive autonomous legislative grant.

records.name: Conseil de la Métropole de Lyon
records.decision_basis: Special municipal/departmental territorial collectivity below the regional tier. CGCT L3611-1–3 gives departmental/metropolitan administration; no separate autonomous regional lawmaking grant established. Keep distinct from the city municipal council.

records.name: Conseil de la Collectivité européenne d’Alsace
records.decision_basis: Departmental grouping with additional cross-border/language/transport functions, not a separate autonomous regional legislature on the operative law reviewed. The April2026 parliamentary proposal is not treated as an enacted change. Preserve future institutional reform as a reopening trigger.

records.name: Comisión de Desarrollo de Isla de Pascua (CODEIPA)
records.decision_basis: Law19253 article67 specifies land allocation/proposals, development projects and environmental/cultural administration; this is not a territorial legislature. Constitutional article126bis and transitional22 contemplate a special statute, not an already-created parliament. The official February2026 consultation is proposal evidence, not enactment.
